commit_message_on_validation:
S2.171 alone let E through on changes before their runtime took it
(its snapshot's run, s7f-s2171, was stopped and carries an ABORTED
file); S2.172 completes it, so both are in this one commit.

Verified by the native units NREADE (tools/golden/native171.txt
n171_reade: "3 0 1 1 1211", on the fields where IBM i and the
interpreter agree) and NWRITEE (tools/golden/native172.txt
n172_writee: "0 0 1 1021") under both engines, as captured on PUB400.
Two interpreter differences are in fidelity.md: READ(E) of a file that
is not open (IBM i sets %ERROR and 01211; the interpreter raises
CPF4135 past E), and an SQL table's primary key, which IBM i takes as a
keyed access path and as4tainr does not.

Full validation on x86_64 (jsr-test-2, s7f-s2172, the snapshot with
S2.170 to S2.172): fmt, clippy (ours), debug and release tests, release
build, demo and native-diff pass. native-diff: level 2 auto 782 tests
the same as under the interpreter; level 2 rust 782 of 782 as under the
interpreter, one program refused (NATSW1, on purpose); coverage 98.7%.
